subject: gk
question: Choose the correct group of greenhouse gases.
solution:
The Correct answer is **CH4, N2 O, CO2, O3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Greenhouse gases (GHGs) are responsible for trapping heat in the Earth’s atmosphere, leading to the **greenhouse effect**, which is a major contributor to **global warming** and **climate change**.
 
• The primary greenhouse gases in the Earth's atmosphere are **carbon dioxide (CO₂)**, **methane (CH₄)**, **nitrous oxide (N₂O)**, and **ozone (O₃)**.
 
• **Carbon dioxide (CO₂)**: Released through processes like **fossil fuel combustion**, **deforestation**, and **industrial activities**.
 
• **Methane (CH₄)**: A potent GHG emitted by sources such as **agriculture (e.g., rice paddies)**, **landfills**, and **livestock digestion (enteric fermentation)**.
 
• **Nitrous oxide (N₂O)**: Emitted from **agricultural soil management**, **fossil fuel combustion**, and some **industrial processes**.
 
• **Ozone (O₃)**: Acts as a GHG in the lower atmosphere (troposphere), although it is beneficial in the upper atmosphere (stratosphere) where it forms the **ozone layer**.
 
• The combination of these gases contributes significantly to the **Earth’s warming** by trapping heat radiated from the planet's surface.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **CH₄, O₂, CO₂, N₂**__

 __
 
• This option incorrectly includes **oxygen (O₂)** and **nitrogen (N₂)**, which are not greenhouse gases.
 
• **Oxygen (O₂)** and **nitrogen (N₂)** are abundant gases in the atmosphere but do not trap heat significantly.
 
 
 
• **CH₄, O₂, CO₂, O₃**__
 __
 
• This option includes **oxygen (O₂)**, which is not a greenhouse gas.
 
• While the other gases listed (CH₄, CO₂, O₃) are greenhouse gases, the presence of oxygen makes this option incorrect.
 
 
 
• **H₂, O₂, CO₂, N₂**__
 
 
• This option incorrectly includes **hydrogen (H₂)** and **oxygen (O₂)**, which are not greenhouse gases.
 
• **Hydrogen (H₂)** is a potential clean energy source but does not contribute to the greenhouse effect.
